method: For every origin:sourced row citing more than one kb id (18 such rows in this skill, 44 cited-id instances total), read each cited record's own source text (fact/target/entity 'text', or research 'snippet'/'read', never the research 'claim' field) and judge whether it genuinely supports the row's specific claim.

totals_previously_unquoted_24_ids.note: This is the apples-to-apples denominator vs. the card-profile trial (165/166): the 24 ids that were NOT already the row's validator-matched quote source, i.e. ids that currently ride for free with no quote of their own.
